summary: Read a list of integers plus two non-negative integers k and t. Look for two different positions whose stored values differ by at most t and whose position numbers differ by at most k. Both limits must hold together. Write true when such a pair exists, and write false when none exists. A pair that meets only one of the two limits does not succeed.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
